summary: Retain structured review test citations and the observed PR base

replay.detail: Existing observations remain valid; no replay or checkpoint change.

schema.detail: Adds optional human.review evidence_tests array and vcs.pull-request base_sha string. No database DDL or storage version change.

rules.detail: No gate or curator rule change.

compatibility.detail: GitHub PR snapshots retain the base SHA from the same read as their head. Legacy observations without these optional fields remain valid, but do not supply them for signing.

manual.detail: Deploy the updated schema to participating daemons before publishing new citation fields. Intake cites immutable records it considered; signing adapters follow separately.

recovery.detail: Re-observe historical snapshots missing the base SHA; never infer their reviewed base from a later main revision.
